kappa.label: kappa
kappa.description: Odd nilpotent symbol of the inhomogeneous deformation; first in PBW order. Not a basis element of C(n+1).

K.label: K
K.description: Even central identity of the pre-oscillator extension A = V + CK + C kappa. Identified with the scalar 1; excluded from the basis and from PBW ordering.

gb_matrix.description: Deformation parameters gb_{a_1^sigma, b_j^s}; label gb_a1{sigma}_b{j}{s}
gb_matrix.parity_note: Formal parity 1 as in C_inhomogeneous_definition.md; in the computation the gb are commuting scalar parameters. With kappa odd this makes [b_j^s, a_1^sigma] = -gb kappa parity-consistent (both sides odd).

deformed_oscillator_relations.boson_fermion: [b_j^s, a_1^sigma] = - gb_a1{sigma}_b{j}{s} * kappa   (sigma, s in {p, m})

inhomogeneous_deformation.description: Deformed graded bracket [X,Y}_gamma = [X,Y}_0 + kappa * gamma(X,Y), computed in the enveloping algebra of the deformed oscillators. gamma is an odd 2-cocycle with values in g~ = g (+) C K; entries with Z = 'K' are the central-identity components.
inhomogeneous_deformation.bracket: [X, Y}_gamma = [X, Y}_0 + kappa * sum_Z gamma_{XY}^Z Z
inhomogeneous_deformation.pair_convention: All ordered pairs (X, Y) with non-zero gamma(X, Y) are listed.
inhomogeneous_deformation.coefficient_format: coeff: printable linear form in the gb symbols; linear_form: {gb_label: rational}
